summary: A four-wheel electric mobility scooter: a moulded front shroud over the steered front wheels with a wire shop… joints seat_swivel, armrest_l, armrest_r, steering, wheel_f_l_roll, wheel_f_l_steer, …; options paint; sockets seat_driver, eye_point, socket_basket, socket_rear.
setup: Spawn it with Prefabs.mobility_scooter or place "prefab": "mobility_scooter" in a scene; Game(plugins=[...]) needs physics3d(), vehicles().
